description: iKuai 3.x/4.x 网关监控。需 Prometheus 抓取 ikuai-exporter；Grafana v13+ Dynamic Dashboard (v2 schema)。

spec.expr: ikuai_network_send_kbytes_per_second{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance"}
ikuai_network_recv_kbytes_per_second{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance"}

sort_desc(ikuai_network_send_kbytes_per_second{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(ip_addr, hostname, comment, mac, ip_version) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"})
ikuai_network_recv_kbytes_per_second{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(ip_addr, hostname, comment, mac, ip_version) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"}
ikuai_network_conn_count{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"}
ikuai_network_send_kbytes_per_second{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(ip_addr, comment) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"}
ikuai_network_recv_kbytes_per_second{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"} * on (id, instance) group_left(ip_addr, comment) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"}
ikuai_network_send_kbytes_per_second{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"} * on(id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance", parent_interface!=""}
ikuai_network_recv_kbytes_per_second{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"} * on(id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance", parent_interface!=""}

spec.description: 公网/WAN 接口实时上下行。v3/v4 通用：不依赖接口 ikuai_uptime；通过 parent_interface 非空筛选 WAN 接口。
spec.title: 公网接口 Network IO/s

spec.expr: sort_desc(increase(ikuai_network_send_bytes{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"}[$__range]) * on(id, instance) group_left(comment, ip_addr) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"})
increase(ikuai_network_recv_bytes{id=~"device/.*", instance="$instance"}[$__range]) * on(id, instance) group_left(comment, ip_addr) ikuai_device_info{instance="$instance"}

sort_desc(increase(ikuai_network_send_bytes{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"}[$__range]) * on(id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance", parent_interface!=""})
increase(ikuai_network_recv_bytes{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"}[$__range]) * on(id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance", parent_interface!=""}
ikuai_network_conn_count{id=~"iface/.*", instance="$instance"} * on(id, instance) group_left(interface, comment) ikuai_iface_info{instance="$instance", parent_interface!=""}

spec.description: 公网/WAN 接口所选时间范围流量与当前连接数。v3/v4 通用：不依赖接口 ikuai_uptime。
spec.title: 公网接口统计

spec.description: 端口映射规则总数。该指标由 dnat 模块提供。
spec.title: DNAT 规则

spec.description: 当前启用的 DNAT/端口映射规则数。
spec.title: 启用映射

spec.description: 当前禁用的 DNAT/端口映射规则数。
spec.title: 禁用映射

spec.description: 当前归属到 DNAT 规则的连接总数。
spec.title: 映射连接

spec.description: iKuai 当前连接会话总数（session 模块，仅 4.x）。3.x 设备无此指标，面板将显示 No data，属正常现象。
spec.title: 当前会话

spec.description: 显示当前 DNAT/端口映射配置。interface 字段由 exporter 原样导出。
spec.title: 端口映射规则

spec.description: 端口映射入站连接明细：入站 IP、Dest IP 等。默认由 exporter 导出 ikuai_dnat_session_info。
spec.title: 端口映射当前连接明细

spec.description: 每条启用 DNAT 规则当前匹配到的连接数，按连接数降序排列。
spec.title: 端口映射当前连接数明细

spec.description: 全量 collect_conn 会话明细，非 DNAT 专用；默认关闭（--session-detail）。查看端口映射入站请使用上方「端口映射当前连接明细」面板。
spec.title: 当前会话明细（可选，非 DNAT）

spec.description: Exporter 能否正常连接爱快设备。
spec.title: 在线状态

spec.description: 各模块采集结果：0=成功，1=失败。3.x 的 session=1 为预期（模块不可用）。
spec.title: 采集器状态
